question: At which time of the day, is the light least scattered?
solution:
The current answer is __**Noon**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• At the time of** noon**, light scatters the least.
 
• Scattering of light **becomes least during noon because the distance between the sun and earth becomes least as compared to that of morning or evening**.
 
• So, the light has to travel a **shorter distance and it also falls on less suspended particles in the atmosphere leading to less scattering**.
 
• As the sun positions overhead during noon time, the light is least scattered which makes the **sun appear white**.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** light is scattered the most** in the **time of morning and evening**.
 
• During **sunrise and sunset**, the **light has to travel a larger part of the atmosphere because the distance between the sun and earth** at that time is larger.
 
• Due to this scattering, the sun appears red during the time of **sunrise and sunset**.
